title: LUBRICATION
summary: Lubrication chart, sheet 1: applied-material codes 1a-1r (99851 lubricant-grease, e.g. door lock rods, window regulator channels, folding top hinges, hood support, headlamp housing bosses) and 2a-2e (9985158 automatic transmission fluid; 9985010 for N40 power steering). Each code gives where it is applied plus the UPC and sub-group of the assembly sheet that uses it.
notes_internal: Table: PART column filled down to every code row of its block (printed once per block). Multi-line cells joined with single spaces; syllable hyphens at line breaks removed (e.g. 'CHAN-NELS' -> 'CHANNELS'), real dashes kept. Diamond symbol after each code omitted.
Part '99851' is printed with only 5 digits (clear, not a hole); copied as printed.
1p UPC: a binder-hole arc sits immediately left of the '7'; '7' is clear but a leading character cannot be fully ruled out.
1p-1r are in the right column with no PART text; treated as continuing 99851 LUBRICANT-GREASE (codes 1a-1r).
2e is listed under the 9985010 block by position, but its usage (prop shaft yoke, UPC 4) does not look like power-steering fluid; block assignment by layout only.
